## The itch

What are you trying to do today that memento makes painful?

## The idea

Describe the feature. If it is a new built-in tool, sketch its schema:

```ts
{
  name: "tool_name",
  description: "…",
  // args, and what mutating means here
}
```

## Why it belongs in memento

- How does it interact with memory / spec / the session log?
- Does it stay deterministic (no model call), or is it a judgment task?
- Would it require a 5th runtime dependency? (If so, argue your case — we
  carry four on purpose.)

## Alternatives

Workarounds you use today, or features elsewhere that solve it.

## Anything else

Screenshots, sketches, or links.
